title: Goal (min) changes editable but unsaveable
body:
When I use the app on my iPad I can edit the Goal of a habit, but when I click the save button it only performs a press button animation but doesn’t do anything else. 

Also I would like to suggest for more units to be available for the Goal feature.

Thanks so much.
author: vchgl

title: I was ripped off
body: I was supposed to get the premium for 91% off as it clearly stated but I was charged full price! They’re not responding to my refund requests!!
author: emzray

title: Loving the app!!
body:
I’m really loving this app and have been using it every day! The design is so simple yet appealing and it works even on my iPhone 5s. However, noticed that I couldn’t open the app (would crash on start) after most recent update. Hoping this problem can be fixed!

Update: Developers responded fast and problem was fixed right away. Thank you developers!! :>
author: Sonsoushous

title: Please add!
body: Please add an option for habits that are done 2-3 times a month please!!!
author: Qshake12

title: Problem integrating Apple Music
body:
Pro-user here. Hope you can fix the error on “listening” habit. When i want to listen to a song, playlist or album or to an audiobook, it does not connect smoothly to the app like apple music or spotify or audible. If you cannot integrate these apps, might as well remove these connections. Also, looking forward for UI improvements and additional customizations, more colors, smaller interface. One last thing, i was surprised that i received a system message that i have reached the maximum number of notifications and that I could still create a habit but without a reminder :( Please fix this. Overall the app is good, with big room for improvement. Looking forward for more updates from the developer. Thanks

——
Im not sure if this is a bug but after updating to ios14, all my habits history were gone. Im mad now. Im using this app for less than a week and all achievements from completing my habits from past days were gone!!! Im trying to reinstall and hope it will capture the data from icloud. The app is working from my ipad. The frustrating part is i havent received any feedback from the developer so I guess ill just fix it myself. #self-service
author: Jerald-PH

body: This is BUILDING GOOD HABITS. But what about QUITTING BAD ones? It doesn't allow me to set SMOKING 0/day.... Count starts with 1.

title: Needs iPadOS Features
body: Please add slide-over and split-window support for the iPad. The best habit building app I’ve used. Keep up the great work.
author: abdelazizalih

title: Simply the best
body: I initially used the free version for a month to get the overall feel and usefulness of the app. I realized how good the free version in tracking my tasks and progress of my habits. Overall, I enjoy keeping up with my habits when using this app! Habit tracking should be simple and straightforward. And HabitMinder makes it sinple yet super fun for me! Now, Im using the pro version and I love it!
author: Juno Lamar

title: Love it but Missing some things
body:
This app itself looks very well designed. Although it could use weekly and monthly settings. More colors and icons would be nice too
And maybe have the icons organized like putting all the food icons together and all the people icons together and etc.

And maybe more options for units like sets or hours, dollars, laps, pieces, rounds, games, glasses, ml, cups, people and stuff like that.

It also kinda has bugs like right after completing a task or pressing the plus sign it freezes for a few seconds before you can press it again which is a little inconvenient if you just want to add a lot
author: GlassLocks

title: Very Helpful
body: This app is very helpful and convenient to use. Recommended for people who wants to see their daily progress in doing their daily routines.
